summary: **Tell us about your request** Please upgrade the version of Docker included in the ECS optimized AMIs to 18.09 or newer **Which service(s) is this request for?** ECS **Tell us about the problem you're trying to solve. What are you trying to do, and why is it hard?** We are using the new secrets functionality included in the latest 1.39 version of the Docker API to pass secrets to our builds in a safe manner. This works great on our local machines but we aren't able to build our dockerfiles using secrets on our ECS clusters due to the ECS optimized AMIs shipping with the older version 18.06.1-
title: [ECS] [request]: Upgrade docker version in ECS-optimized AMIs
